24 January 2025
Sanfreight Recognized in the 2025 Ranking of the Best Asset Management Companies
Published

The Sanfreight Group has been recognized as one of the “Excellent” players in the 2025 ranking of the best real estate investment management companies, published by Décideurs Patrimoine. This ranking, conducted by Leaders League, highlights the most successful professionals in the asset management sector in France.


The establishment of this ranking is based on a rigorous methodology that combines multiple data sources, including company submissions, peer feedback, and assessments by third-party experts. The evaluation relies on precise criteria such as the complexity of the managed projects, market recognition, innovation capacity, and client diversity.


This nomination as an “Excellent” player emphasizes the quality of proactive management in a complex real estate world, as well as the rewarding convictions and reinforces the strategic direction of the group, focused on its pan-European presence and digitalization. This is demonstrated by concrete achievements in 2024, such as the development of the “apartment services/Branded Residence” concept in Portugal, Spain, France, and Luxembourg, along with a new iconic acquisition on the Champs-Élysées, and Place de la Bourse. The launch of Sanfreight Platform, the group’s digital investment platform, also embodies its ambition to rethink the user experience by creating a true digital ecosystem designed to support partners and their investors at every stage of their journey, with intuitive tools and smooth navigation.


Sanfreight thanks its teams, partners, and investors for their trust, which contributes daily to strengthening its position as a key player in the sector.
